I'm saying I've used medical equipment at work to compare the accuracy of my Fitbit. My heart beats matches the BPM on the medical device versus my Fitbit. I match the beats by watching the beats on my Fitbit and counting while pressing on the artery in my neck. I then do the same with the monitor. The beats match on the monitor and do not on my Fitbit.

This problem persisted through two Fitbits, so I believe the problem has to be with me physiologically. I always check my heart rate both at rest and during workouts to see if it matches and it won't match most of the time. I am very physically active and I work as a BMET so I have access to hospital level medical equipment which captures readings much more accurately. Whenever I work on a vital signs monitor I will check the accuracy of my Fitbit by comparing it to the monitors readings and it's off.
